_source: Estimated from the cubby-constraint-reference-model (a stand-in for a 3D scan of the cubby) by 'python tools/rav4shelf.py reference --write-params'. That file is not in the repo; only these numbers describing the cavity are. The same values are the defaults in params/default.json.
_model: Side walls: one circular arc seen from the front (wall_radius, wall_lean_deg at z_ref) moved along the depth with a linear taper (W_rear_delta). Rear corners: chamfer + two fillets. Roof: flat at H_cubby with a pocket in the middle that rises toward the front.
_assumptions: Not in the file, assumed: its lowest points reach the Qi pad, its front is 8 mm behind the lip, its back 1 mm from the rear wall. The car's walls may be a little outside this envelope (unknown clearance): set envelope_offset from the fit coupon.
_fit: side walls rms 0.14 / max 0.83 mm (1150 points), rear corners max 0.47 mm, roof rms 0.09 / max 0.83 mm
